t: The Pegler PB300 compression full bore 22mm ball valve provides reliable flow control for various systems. Featuring a quarter turn operation and a full bore design, it ensures efficient fluid management with a maximum flow rate of 683.3Ltr/min. This robust valve is rated PN16 and suitable for water, steam, oil, and air applications, making it ideal for plumbing installations in domestic and commercial settings. Constructed from chrome-plated brass with a PTFE seat and anti-blowout stem, it offers durability and a wide operating temperature range from -10 °C to 120 °C. Demountable and reusable.
b: Suitable for Water, Oil & Gas Systems (Excluding Oxygen)
Quick 1/4 Turn Operation for Fast Flow Control
Full Bore Design Ensures Maximum Flow & Efficiency
Robust PN16 Rating for High Pressure Systems
